overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state serialization for endgame snapshots and optimizing Monte Carlo convergence metrics. This batch closes the loop on long-running simulation stability and provides precise, low-overhead state recovery mechanisms for the 5,500+ tick campaign horizon.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Copy Deterministic State Snapshotter
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot capture time < 1ms for 5,500 tick state.
Zero heap allocations during Capture/Restore cycle.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Instant save/load with no stutter; reliable rollback for debugging.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Convergence Check for 100% Survival
acceptance_criteria: Convergence detected within 1000 samples for stable systems.
Variance calculation matches IEEE 754 reference within 1e-7.
No dynamic resizing of sample buffer.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster simulation ticks; clearer feedback on system stability.

tasks.title: Compact Footstep Log Compression (16,500 entries)
acceptance_criteria: Decompression is O(N) and branchless where possible.
Memory footprint reduced by > 60% vs naive struct array.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Smaller save files; faster loading of long campaigns.
